guide_basis.decision_note: Ranges and T are researcher choices, not values prescribed by the guide. Six NAS decisions are conservative for adapted/own variants; published bodies remain frozen.

contract.primary_metric: mean of per-seed RMSE in original units
contract.final_test_role: 608 known dates; exploratory; support not yet certified

common_hpo.method: seeded stratified random; frozen candidate list before fits
common_hpo.weight_decay_scope: weight matrices only; biases and normalization parameters exempt
common_hpo.loss: MSE of sigma7 divided by positive training mean
common_hpo.supervised_selection: lowest original-unit validation RMSE; strict improvement; earliest epoch on equal score
common_hpo.scheduler: cosine decay after warmup; minLR0; default warmup0; epoch caps50/200 respected
common_hpo.batch_singleton_rule: if remainder1 split preceding full batch into batch_size-1 and2; keep all rows; require at least2 train examples
common_hpo.failure_policy: NaN/inf/divergence/timeout/OOM consume configuration and stage allocation; preserve run records, no replacement seed/trial. Systematic implementation error blocks campaign, requires correction and affected reruns under amendment.
common_hpo.refit: Fresh model, optimizers and train-only scalers. For each origin/recipe use ceil(median(best epochs)) of selected HPO configuration's two seeds (nonNAS) or winning NAS finalist's five phase2 seeds, per phase separately. Freeze those counts for every new refit seed; no outer-label early stopping. Count AE1/AE2/supervised separately.
common_hpo.auxiliary_objective: MSE reconstructing X/s; fresh optimizer each AE stage; select on inner-validation reconstruction loss with same patience; full200/short50 epoch caps per stage
common_hpo.configuration_selection: Smallest mean original-unit validation RMSE across the two HPO seeds; exact-score tie resolved by stable trial ID. NAS uses its distinct five-seed architecture selection rule.

architecture.details: AE1: LSTM5→w1, repeat7, decoder LSTMw1→w1 y Linearw1→5+tanh. AE2 recibe vector finalAE1 repetido7, LSTMw1→w2, repeat7, decoder LSTMw2→w2 y Linearw2→5+tanh. AE1.eval(), dropout inactivo y sin gradientes al generar las entradas de AE2; pesos AE1 congelados en esa fase. En supervisado los encoders transferidos son entrenables y b1/b2 vuelven a estar activos. Predictor encoders transferidos→Densew2→w3+ReLU→Linear1+Softplus. X/s como target auxiliar; no escalar entrada encoder por s. b1/b2 aplican dropout0.2 a vector encoder y secuencia decoder antes de proyección de reconstrucción; b3 tras ReLU densa; decoders descartados en predictor. En inferencia dropout inactivo.

Diez momentos sólo al readout final. bi tras salida completa del bloque; no cambiar escalas/tiempos entre arquitecturas.

architecture.details: Correspondencia aproximada: un bloque residual encoder de ancho w1, decoder de ancho w2 y decoder temporal oculto w3; latente8 y salida temporal8 fijos, featureencoder5→64→4 e identidadvariable16 fijos. Proyecciones de entrada/salida y atajos se dimensionan al grupo; b1,b2,b3 tras la salida completa del bloque residual encoder, decoder y temporal, respectivamente. architecture.details: Tres bloques con proyecciones lineales entre anchos; heads_i=wi/16 y FF_i=8wi. Desactivar uniformemente la acumulación de atención residual entre capas, pues cambia número de cabezas. bi activa dropout0.2 tras atención y FF del bloque; atención probabilística interna con dropout0 fijo. RevIN antes de padding9izquierda/8derecha, patch16 stride8 y dos parches fijos. Readout5*2*w3+10; cabeza sin dropout adicional.

nas.patterns: all eight bit triplets; no pruning
nas.k_rule: Use global k40 for every NAS model if any model noise-pilot median pairwise Spearman correlation of full-budget ranks across5 seeds is <0.5 or not estimable; otherwise global k20. Freeze before full phase1. k40 is a resource cap, not optimality guarantee.
nas.reference_addition: If reference already among k distinct finalists do not repeat it; budget conservatively reserves k+1
nas.hpo_order: First tune nonarchitecture HPO on reference; then freeze winning nonarchitecture values before1000 NAS designs.
nas.remaining_dropout: all newly searched block positions controlled solely by bit pattern at p0.2; other dropout0
nas.selection: minimize mean validation RMSE; within delta of lowest mean or overlapping nominal95% mean-score t intervals, select fewest total predictor params, then lowest mean RMSE, then stable architecture id; overlap is tie rule, not equivalence proof

budget.scope: search, resource/noise pilots, power pilot and selected-model refits only; not total scientific campaign
budget.final_seed_rule: Choose common R between6 and30 after paired power pilot and multiplicity-aware temporal simulation targeting0.80. If requiredR>30, report achievable power/MDE and exploratory limits; do not claim achieved power0.80.
budget.noise_pilot_scope: Global development-only pilot at origin2023-10-01; all inputs and labels through2023-09-23. Before earliest2024 outer origin; no2024 or final data. Reused only for global k and resource estimates, never candidate selection at later origins.
budget.noise_pilot_architecture_selection: reference plus smallest000 and largest111, plus9 stratified seeded unique candidates fixed before timing; all6 families share width/bit patterns
budget.profiling_scope: At origin2023-10-01 with same historical support as noise pilot; one full-budget fit each for five nonNAS candidates and three E1 references. NAS timings reuse noise pilot.
budget.power_pilot_scope: after selection of recipes; development-only common held pilot; must not retroactively tune candidates
excluded_work: negative label controls and other leakage fits
budget.power_pilot_recipe_basis: Use recipes selected at2024-10-01 inner selection; refit through2024-10-31 with frozen hyperparameters, then evaluate53 development dates2024-11-08..2024-12-30. Do not select hyperparameters/architectures on power-pilot labels. Pilot variance may not represent final-origin recipes; disclose that limit.

noise_and_resource_pilot_fixed_nonarchit.optimizer: AdamW using common fixed betas/epsilon/loss/normalization and epoch rules
noise_and_resource_pilot_fixed_nonarchit.dropout_non_nas: existing dropout0.1 for TSMixer,iTransformer and neural references;0 for source CNNs
noise_and_resource_pilot_fixed_nonarchit.dropout_nas: solely declared architecture bits at p0.2
noise_and_resource_pilot_fixed_nonarchit.scope: Fixed before2023 pilot. Never reuse HPO winners from2024 or2025 and never select candidates on pilot scores. No additional HPO.

justified_fixed_axes.all: D7×5 and h1 inherited; no context extension, teacher forcing not applicable to scalar h1.
justified_fixed_axes.published_bodies: Depth/width, kernels and normalization fixed by published-body route§14. New kernels/normalization would change recipe and decision.
justified_fixed_axes.transformer_heads: iTransformer H8 fixed by source; PatchTST NAS heads=wi/16; do not independently sample invalid dimensions.
justified_fixed_axes.normalization: Architecture-dependent normalization frozen per declared recipe, with train-only statistics and eval freeze.

justified_fixed_axes.published_CNN_dropout: No existing dropout module, keep rate0; do not add layers and still call body unchanged.
